verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe an SDK to embed and customize Activepieces in your SaaS, with the builder embedded in your app and users provisioned automatically. The pricing page explicitly offers the flow builder, agents and integrations 'inside your own product, under your own brand,' and an embeddable MCP flow extends this to embedded users. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of white-label branding and theming controls, independent or hands-on corroboration of the embedding experience, and clarity on which plan tier includes embedding.
